content.text: Menú DESTINATIONS Albacete Alicante Antequera Barcelona Calatayud Castellón Ciudad Real Córdoba Cuenca Elche Figueres Gijón Granada Cuenca León Lleida Loja Madrid Málaga Medina del Campo Murcia Orihuela Ourense Palencia Puertollano Segovia Sevilla Talavera de la Reina Tarragona Toledo Valencia Valladolid Villanueva de Córdoba Villena Zamora Zaragoza MAGAZINE PARTNERS English Spanish French Palencia Palencia EXPERIENCES Palencia is a welcoming and family-friendly city, rich in heritage and filled with green spaces. It is one of the cities with the most green spaces per inhabitant in the country and is home to the tallest Christ statue in Spain—the Cristo del Otero, standing at 21 meters high. Palencia is a flat city that holds most of its tourist attractions within its urban center—a rich heritage where traces of every historical period of the city have been preserved. Palencia is full of experiences worth living, whether as a couple, with family, or in a group. The International Jazz Festival and Palencia Sonora are must-attend events for music lovers. The kitchens of Palencia are filled with the scent of history. Among its most popular dishes are roast lamb and suckling pig, pork products, stewed pigeon, and the exquisite Saldaña beans. palenciaturismo.es Essential MAPA CIUDAD
